name: Fuad Davids
qualifications: LLB, LLM (Environmental Law), ADR, Safety, Health, Environment and Quality (SHEQ) Representative, PG.Dip Climate Change and Energy Law
membership: Legal Practice Council, Environmental Law Association, Association of Arbitrators (Southern Africa) NPC
projects: Legal advisor on the panels of the KZN Department of Economic Development, Tourism and Environmental Affairs (EDTEA), Transnet, Dube TradePort Corporation and other public bodies in KwaZulu-Natal and the Western Cape. Also assists private developers with environmental compliance and litigation.
bio: Fuad Davids is an experienced attorney and full-time legal practitioner in environmental law, holding LLB and LLM degrees from the University of the Western Cape. His postgraduate research focused on the use of criminal sanctions in prosecuting environmental crimes. He also holds a Postgraduate Diploma in Climate Change and Energy Law, has completed qualifications in Arbitration with the Association of Arbitrators SA, and received specialised training in mediation within the construction sector. He has further developed expertise in renewable energy, infrastructure projects, litigation and commercial advisory work.

Fuad heads both the Environmental Law and Litigation departments at HSG. He provides environmental compliance and litigation services to private and public clients, supporting projects from inception to completion. His experience spans regulatory compliance, litigation before the Magistrates’ Court, High Court, and Supreme Court of Appeal, as well as construction and infrastructure law and renewable energy projects.
